cues.text: KineGate: a ticker and a good-looking price are not enough. Bind the issuer, clocks and exact intention before acting.
Preflight uses FIXTURE data. Evidence includes REPLAY of real API acquisition. No wallet, signed transaction or broadcast; this is the actual yellow/black product.
One $50 intention. Thirteen deterministic checks cover identity, permission, clocks, balance, cost, vendor and effects.
The local receipt binds every input using canonical JSON and SHA-256. A hash proves internal consistency, not issuer authenticity.
Local simulation records this bound fixture once per browser session. No chain transaction is sent.
Change the amount to $51: the previous receipt becomes invalid. KineGate does not invent a new quote.
The weekend case waits: stale independent reference plus a closed underlying market. Closure is policy context, not a universal DEX ban.
Same ticker, different issuer: the exact intended claim does not match. A ticker cannot substitute for issuer-specific rights.
Restore a valid fixture, then advance the virtual clock 60 seconds: the receipt expires and dependent evidence must be refreshed.
Same sixteen authored fixtures: a simplified price-only rule accepts thirteen policy-unsafe cases; KineGate accepts none. This is not a real-world accuracy estimate.
REPLAY of four authenticated Binance RWA calls: HTTP200 and business code0. Exact AAPLon issuer and contract agree; absent execution evidence remains WAIT.
A real 6 USDT quote succeeded: LiquidMesh, actual mode SWAP. This is a recorded quote, with no declared expiry or minimum output and no trade authorization.
The unsigned SWAP builder and actual off-chain simulation returned HTTP200 and code0. Predicted execution FAILED: token balance insufficient. No signature, approval or broadcast.
The pinned-block BSC read matches current API-listed AAPLon: code, symbol, eighteen decimals. Contract existence does not prove liquidity or settlement.
Mainnet settlement remains unverified. Asset signing needs separate human authorization; the required DevEx report must be personally authored.
Run it without a wallet. Inspect the code, exported receipt, test evidence and documented limitations. Evidence before action.
